definition.population: Adult ICU stays, first observed creatinine-defined AKI episode; known chronic dialysis and prior RRT excluded
definition.prediction_times: ICU hour 12 onward, every 6h, through hour 168
definition.onset: first availability time of a result meeting creatinine KDIGO-2012 research criteria
definition.baseline: minimum earlier observed creatinine within 7 days, including available pre-ICU measurements
definition.negative_label: full 24h ICU follow-up and a creatinine result available in hours 18-24 of horizon
limitations: Unknown pre-admission AKI/CKD can be misclassified
Intermittent testing can miss true physiologic onset
Urine intervals not inferred from irregular source charting
Source demo sampling is not representative of all hospitals
